title: wait
description: Pause before the next action, in milliseconds. `true` pauses for 5000 milliseconds, and `false` skips the step.

anyOf.title: Wait (simple)
anyOf.$comment: One type array: AJV runs with coerceTypes and coerces only when a value matches none of the listed types, so true stays true and 1 stays 1. Number is listed first because the LSP offers the first listed type as the value kind. As separate branches, a leading number branch turned true into 1, and a leading boolean branch would turn 1 into true. Strings still coerce: "5000" becomes 5000 and "true" becomes true. See ADR 01161.
